claims.text: The CNN-based sentence classifier achieved the best results in all three sub-tasks.
The CNN outperforms the RNN model, achieving a macro-F1 score of 0.80.
The CNN system achieved higher performance in this experiment compared to the BiLSTM, with a macro-F1 score of 0.69.
All three models achieved similar results far surpassing the random baselines, with a slight performance edge for the neural models.
